text_block_list.text: I spot Narita Brian at the academy after a break.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …I went out to the sticks for a student council inspection.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: But the president can't pass up a good time. She's got to sample the local cuisine, visit the hot springs, yada yada…

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: An "inspection," she called it… Can you believe that?
It seems like Narita Brian had a nice, relaxing time with her friends.
